name: a-video-tab-pops-out-when-you-leave-it
description:
Of the auto mini player: under autoMiniPlayer 'audible', a tab playing a video with sound goes to picture-in-picture when the user switches away from it. The page never registers the mediaSession enterpictureinpicture action, which is what separates 'audible' from Chromium's own 'siteAsks' rule - stock Chromium would leave this video in its tab.

The page is loaded over file:// because AutoPictureInPictureTabHelper only ever autopips an https:// or file:// URL, and because the media engagement gate passes a file origin without a visit history the probe VM does not have. --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required stands in for the click a user would give it.

The picture-in-picture window is a native VideoOverlayWindowViews with no CDP target of its own, so the proof is read from the page that owns the video: document.pictureInPictureElement names the element once it has moved out.

actions.note: the command bar, because restore refuses a file:// row (rust/atrium-core/src/restore.rs scheme_allowed) so the page cannot come from the spaces fixture
first, because it also warms the debugging tunnel the eval_until below would otherwise spend its whole budget on
a later 'in-tab' must mean the gate refused, not that the video never started
previousTab, the tab switch away - cmd+shift+left is previousSPACE and changes no tab at all

assertions.desc: the video really is playing with sound before the switch
nothing has popped out while the tab is still the active one
Leaving the tab moved the video to the mini player
